documents.title: COMPLIANCE OF REGULATION 33 OF SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURES REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015 FOR M/S. VIKRAM THERMO (INDIA) LIMITED.
Board Meeting Outcome for COMPLIANCE OF REGULATION 30 OF SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURES REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015 FOR M/S. VIKRAM THERMO (INDIA) LIMITED. (COMPANY CODE BSE: 530477)
Board Meeting Intimation for INTIMATION OF BOARD MEETING UNDER REGULATION 29(1)(A) OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS 2015

analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo's management reported on financial performance for the year ended March 31, 2025, noting a revenue of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operations and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 809.85 lakhs, which decreased compared to the previous year due to the demerger of the Aromatic Chemicals business. The company successfully executed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, with shares of the resulting company commencing trade on March 6, 2025. Additionally, the board recommended a final dividend of 10% (Rs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10 each for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to further spend appropriate amount towards its obligation of the current financial year during 2023-24 as well.
management_commitments.quote: it is committed to further spend appropriate amount towards its obligation of the current financial year during 2023-24 as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue on its journey of transformation by venturing into new markets and working on new and complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.
